# Does the EU Deforestation Regulation cover your products, and what must you do by when?

> Free EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) checker: tick your role, size and commodities to see whether Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 covers you, your duties with the Articles, and your application date. Screens customs codes against Annex I. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
